svg.title: DreamCarve phase 4 wireframe: preview controls
svg.text: 09 · Toolpath visibility and depth colouring (capabilities 72–74): By depth mode, arrows on, program extents on, the Pocket regenerating (faded).
Program extents X −6.35..156.35 Y −6.35..96.35 Z −12.2..5 (edge of the bit, dashed)
By depth colours every cutting move from pale
at the stock top to dark at the deepest cut.
rapid at safe Z or clearance
tab mark: a pass rising over a tab
start point: bit circle, tick = first cut
drill hole: the bit at each hole
Faded = regenerating; the row shows a spinner
